item.title: Apache Superset Extensions - Taking Open Source BI to the Next Level
item.description: Apache Superset has always been leading the charge on open-source BI, but now it’s getting ready to truly take over the BI world. Learn all about Superset’s new extensions architecture that will allow users and developers to more rapidly expand and improve the product’s capabilities, while simplifying life for both developers and maintainers.
